status: visual semantics and golden verified; Phase 2.2 integration gates remain open

items.note: All engines sample the same finite affine grid on the world-Z plane through its nodal centre. Peaks and purple/teal/yellow ordering agree. Native scalar interpolation has smooth boundaries; reference filtering and PyMOL legend differ.

reference_notes: Mol* VolumeTransform authors the canonical MolFrame affine; finite-grid periodicity is explicitly none, preventing Slice from reconstructing a translated map as a periodic origin-zero cell.
PyMOL Slice retains its map-local geometry. Applying the map object transform to the slice restores the canonical world placement.
Reference colours use all ten evenly spaced palette anchors; native HDR slice colours are scene-linear.
performance: Correctness and visual review; no optimization claim.
